collection.description: A young naturalist observes a Golden Pigmy in a brackish inlet, but another observer disputes its fin shape.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A young naturalist observes a Golden Pigmy in a brackish inlet and believes its curious swimming pattern may distinguish it from other fish. Another observer disagrees about the fin shape.

choices.label: Sketch it from a safe distance
Keep a living specimen briefly for observation

d.name: Answer D
d.text: The fish disappears for days. When it returns, a different observer notes a variation that complicates the original classification.
